subject: Daz
fact: Daz refused to break posture when Glabbagool spoke, saying 'I'm taking care of this, it's fine.'
source_quote: Glabbagool, I'm taking care of this, it's fine.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the small wet sound of Glabbagool opening his eyes and tracking left and right.
source_quote: I heard — I am fairly certain I heard — the small wet sound of him opening his eyes, which then began tracking left and right with the particular energy of someone who absolutely cannot help himself.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree questioned whether Daz was a wizard who prays to Lolth.
source_quote: You're a wizard. A wizard… a wizard who prays to Lolth?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz claimed he was speaking through the body that had communed with Lolth.
source_quote: I am… you are not speaking to the wizard of this body. I… he… this body has communed with Lolth. And I… I am speaking through this body.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree realized Daz was testing her discernment as a follower of Lolth.
source_quote: you are trying to test me, to see if I was one of those fake followers of Lolth, who are willing to believe every charlatan magic user that is somehow being possessed by the power of Lolth.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree asked whether Daz and Glabbagool had been infected by the spores of Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: have you two been infected by the spores, possessed by the crazed magic of Zuggtmoy? convinced of the bride's power? Is this another trick of Ilvara's?

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree believes in the foulness of Ilvara and desires her death with theological fervor.
source_quote: Ilvara, who was once a high priestess of Lolth, has become seduced by this abomination, this idea that Lolth wishes to be married. There is something foul and stinking about her, and then all of those allies she seems to covet have turned into fungal creatures that are mindless. We need to kill her. We need to butcher her! We need to send her to an unearthly grave! I fear that her disease will spread.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz stated he already feels the gratitude of Lolth.
source_quote: I already feel the gratitude of Lolth. I have that.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said the conviction he shows is the kind this follower of Lolth shows.
source_quote: It's the kind of conviction this follower of Lolth shows.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree admitted she was not going to kill Ilvara herself and needed Daz to do it.
source_quote: I was not going to kill her. That is what you… where you come in.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree said she thought Daz had strong allies with tactical awareness and destructive magic.
source_quote: I thought you had strong allies, who had a tactical awareness and understanding how to use their magic for destructive purposes.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree told Daz not to touch her.
source_quote: Don't touch me.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed Asha Vandree treated him as furniture during the conversation.
source_quote: She filed me away and returned her eyes to Daz. Not a glance afterward. Not a word in my direction for the duration of the conversation.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted Asha Vandree's question about infection by Zuggtmoy's spores as a test of panic.
source_quote: Asha's opening had been a pointed thing — "Have you two been infected by the spores, possessed by the crazed magic of Zuggtmoy? Convinced of the bride's power? Is this another trick of Ilvara's?" — the kind of question designed to see what shape your panic takes.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said he really believes he has been infected by spores and that he has convinced others to join him.
source_quote: I really do believe that I have. Perhaps there are some spores within me, but I… it feels… I feel it. And by the way, I've convinced others to join me.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool began to form the shape of an utterance during the negotiation.
source_quote: The ooze had, apparently, opinions about the negotiation. It began to form the shape of an utterance — which is not something you want from what is supposed to be an inanimate ooze familiar — and Daz caught it with the ease of someone who has managed Glabbagool before.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum explained he had Glyph of Warding, Dust of Suleiman, and Phantasmal Killer, but only one 4th-level spell slot.
source_quote: So these powerful spells I've been talking about… they're all 4th level, and I only have one fourth level slot. I can only cast one.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes Phantasmal Killer is a just spell because it taps into a creature's deepest fears.
source_quote: A spell that reaches into something's mind and pulls out what it's afraid of. Bahamut didn't teach me that one, exactly, but I don't think he'd object. Some fears are just.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum laid out his three 4th-level spells as keys for one lock.
source_quote: Three keys. One lock. The planning was, in a sense, just a very elaborate way of deciding which door we most needed to open.

subject: Glabbagool's nature
fact: Glabbagool is supposed to be an inanimate ooze familiar but speaks and moves, and his true nature is unexplained.
source_quote: The ooze had, apparently, opinions about the negotiation. It began to form the shape of an utterance — which is not something you want from what is supposed to be an inanimate ooze familiar.

subject: Zalthir's role
fact: Zalthir was present during the entire negotiation but never acknowledged by Asha Vandree, and his contribution remains unstated.
source_quote: She filed me away and returned her eyes to Daz. Not a glance afterward. Not a word in my direction for the duration of the conversation.

subject: Asha Vandree's fear of contamination
fact: Asha Vandree fears fungal contamination personally and deeply, but the origin of this fear is not specified.
source_quote: Don't touch me.

subject: The Heart Fungus
fact: The Heart Fungus is mentioned as a risk, but its nature and location are not clarified.
source_quote: The artifact was the other risk. Contain both and the job was done.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree believes the Heart Fungus is the key to Ilvara's control, and that infrastructure demolition is more valuable than direct attacks on Ilvara.
source_quote: That's an obvious one — use it on the big heart fungus.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree reluctantly engages with the party, showing visible effort to speak to them.
source_quote: I could hear the slight effort it cost her to engage with us at all.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree holds deep disdain for the party, especially the speaker, and refuses to speak to them directly.
source_quote: She was, apparently, briefly impressed. 'Well put, well put,' she said. 'This was just a test. Don't touch me.'

subject: Asha Vandree's belief
fact: Asha Vandree says 'I believe' about the origin of the spore illness, undermining her own authority and leaving the truth unverified.
source_quote: I believe.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree has rejected Ilvara’s bride heresy and clings to Lolth’s faith as her reason for remaining uninfected.
source_quote: Me, because I have diligently kept the faith to Lolth, and have rejected all of these claims of the bride heresy.

subject: Jorlan's grievance
fact: Jorlan hates Ilvara for something or other, but the specific reason is unstated and unresolved.
source_quote: Jorlan, because apparently he really hates Ilvara for something or other.

subject: Jorlan and Asha's history
fact: Jorlan and Ilvara once had an affair, she broke up with him, and he has been bitter ever since — a personal history the session leaves unexplored.
source_quote: They used to have an affair, it used to be this whole thing, and then she broke up with him, and then he was bitter because she broke up with him.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree expresses genuine exasperation and emotional vulnerability about being stuck between Jorlan and Ilvara’s past relationship.
source_quote: Do you have any idea how aggravating that is?

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree shows unexpected warmth and agreement when the speaker comments on the complexity of relationships.
source_quote: I agree!" she said, with a warmth she'd shown none of us since we'd met her.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree considers Daz more impressive after learning he has an ooze familiar, shifting her perception of him.
source_quote: An ooze familiar," she said, looking at Daz now with something approaching respect. I could tell that she's now even more impressed with Daz, for securing the services of an ooze familiar.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree identifies the spore servants as former drow who embraced Ilvara’s power and the ecstasy of the spores.
source_quote: They are the drow of our party whom have totally succumbed to Ilvara's power... who embraced the spores and the ecstasy that came through them.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree knows the Heart Fungus does not cause fungal disease beyond poisoning, pain, and breathing difficulties, but only believes the spore illness originates from Ilvara’s spores.
source_quote: The particular spore illness only originates from Ilvara's spores and from her mushroom. I believe.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree reveals that only she and Jorlan are no longer captured by Ilvara’s spores.
source_quote: The only three people who are no longer captured by her spores are myself and Jorlan.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin recognizes Jorlan’s predictable rage and uses it to trigger the Glyph of Warding, turning his emotional state into tactical leverage.
source_quote: Come get it, idiot!

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin accepts a light crossbow from the speaker, acknowledging his lack of ranged capability and choosing to contribute despite his limitations.
source_quote: So someone lends me a crossbow, and I take it, because I'd rather be in the fight badly than out of it entirely.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin engages Jorlan in melee combat after the glyph detonates, landing a 14-damage hit and applying Sap to gain advantage.
source_quote: The first hit lands true. Fourteen damage, and I roll through the Sap, put him off-balance, give him disadvantage on whatever's coming back at me.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin swings wide with Dawnbringer, rolling a natural 2, and fails to land a second hit on Jorlan despite his staggered state.
source_quote: The second swing goes wide... I'm rolling a 2 and there's nothing in the world that fixes a 2.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is deeply concerned about spore infection and believes the party’s caution is justified.
source_quote: You worry about these things a lot. Yes," Zalthir said. "We do, yeah," I agreed.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir devises the final plan: teleporting in, grappling Ilvara, and dropping her into the Phantasmal Killer to damage both her and the Heart Fungus simultaneously.
source_quote: I can try to grab Ilvara and drop her into that, such that you're hurting both of them, and then the rest of you can fireball or whatever from there.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is the only one Asha respects enough to speak to directly after the speaker loses her favor.
source_quote: My dear boy," she said, and then looked at me with contempt, and then turned to Daz.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz smooths over the party’s caution about spores by framing it as tactical wisdom and seeking expert guidance, earning Asha’s brief approval.
source_quote: Our caution came from unfamiliarity with mushroom-related side effects, and that asking for expert guidance was tactically sound rather than ignorant.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is perceived by Asha as the owner of an ooze familiar, which elevates his status in her eyes.
source_quote: An ooze familiar," she said, looking at Daz now with something approaching respect.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is the one who inscribes the Glyph of Warding on the bridge, knowing it will kill anyone crossing it — including Jorlan — without discrimination.
source_quote: I finished the inscription and straightened up. The bridge was now a threshold. Everything on the far side of it was already committed to a detonation it didn't know about yet.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is the one who decides to trigger the glyph on Jorlan’s side, acknowledging Jorlan is not an ally despite his hatred of Ilvara.
source_quote: Okay," I said. "And then, I guess the trigger is — anyone approaching from the side that Jorlan is on.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is an ooze creature mistaken for a familiar by the party to explain his presence, and he does not seem to mind the misclassification.
source_quote: Thorin introduced Glabbagool as Daz's familiar. Glabbagool blinked. Probably didn't mind.

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker acknowledges Asha’s tactical insight about the Heart Fungus being more important than Ilvara’s personal destruction, and chooses to use the Dust of Suleiman on the fungus.
source_quote: I took notes on the whole plan, the way I always do... The Dust of Suleiman on the fungus, because Asha was right and the infrastructure was more important than the satisfying image of Ilvara's nightmares eating her alive.

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker recognizes the moral ambiguity of the glyph — it kills without discrimination, and they cannot inscribe one that only kills drow they dislike.
source_quote: I don't know how to inscribe a glyph that will only kill the drow that we don't like.

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker takes emotional notes on Asha Vandree, seeing her as more human than they initially believed, despite her hostility.
source_quote: I took notes. Not on the tactics — on Asha, who was more person than I'd given her credit for, even if she refused to speak to me directly.

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker hands Thorin their light crossbow, recognizing his need to contribute meaningfully despite his lack of ranged capability.
source_quote: I can lend you my light crossbow. It's a small thing. But everyone needs a way to contribute when it starts.

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker reflects on Ilvara’s possible nightmares and considers using Phantasmal Killer, but ultimately defers to the more strategic plan.
source_quote: What does she dream about? What would an illusory manifestation of her deepest fears look like?

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker notes the final plan in their mind, not on paper — every spell, every role, every consequence accounted for.
source_quote: I took notes on the whole plan, the way I always do. Not on paper. In my head. Every piece placed, every spell accounted for.

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker chooses to target the Heart Fungus over Ilvara’s personal destruction, accepting Asha’s insight as correct.
source_quote: The Dust of Suleiman on the fungus, because Asha was right and the infrastructure was more important than the satisfying image of Ilvara's nightmares eating her alive.

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is standing on the Glyph of Warding, unaware of its presence, and is lured onto it by Thorin’s provocation.
source_quote: Jorlan charges. He comes straight onto the bridge, straight onto the glyph...

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is bitter, enraged, and emotionally wounded by Ilvara’s rejection, making him a predictable target.
source_quote: Jorlan... bitter-eyed, nursing whatever wound his pride has taken since Ilvara discarded him.

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is a former drow who has not been infected by Ilvara’s spores, but is not allied with the party.
source_quote: The only three people who are no longer captured by her spores are myself and Jorlan.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum carefully inscribed the Glyph of Warding into the stone of the bridge, anticipating its use against Jorlan.
source_quote: the Glyph of Warding that Grygum spent real patience setting into the stone of the bridge.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is the one who teleports to Ilvara, grapples her, and drops her into the Phantasmal Killer to damage both her and the Heart Fungus.
source_quote: I can try to grab Ilvara and drop her into that, such that you're hurting both of them...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is hit hard by the Heart Fungus’s spore cloud and must climb ten feet to breathe.
source_quote: It unleashes a cloud of spores that hits Zalthir so hard he has to climb ten feet straight up just to breathe.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is the one who identifies the emotional core of the party’s fear of spores by pointing to Daz as proof of infection.
source_quote: I mean, — look at him! He's already infected. I don't want to be infected.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is infected by spores — visibly altered — and serves as a visual warning to the party.
source_quote: I mean, — look at him! He's already infected.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is corrupted by fungal growth, preoccupied with the mushroom token, and has transformed into a being whose control is tied to the Heart Fungus.
source_quote: She was on an elevated platform. Corrupted. The fungal growth had changed her in ways that were specific and terrible — the scourge still in her hand, but everything else altered.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is the source of the spore illness and the one who seduced drow into embracing the ecstasy of the spores.
source_quote: who embraced the spores and the ecstasy that came through them.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara was once romantically involved with Jorlan, and their breakup left him bitter and broken.
source_quote: They used to have an affair... and then she broke up with him, and then he was bitter because she broke up with him.

subject: The Heart Fungus
fact: The Heart Fungus is the central mechanism of Ilvara’s power, and its destruction dismantles her control over the area.
source_quote: The Heart Fungus was the key. That was her point, and she wasn't wrong. The fungus was how Ilvara kept control over the whole area.

subject: The Heart Fungus
fact: The Heart Fungus emits a deadly spore cloud when threatened, targeting Zalthir and others.
source_quote: It unleashes a cloud of spores that hits Zalthir so hard he has to climb ten feet straight up just to breathe.

subject: The Heart Fungus
fact: The Heart Fungus shudders from the force of the Glyph of Warding’s detonation on Jorlan.
source_quote: the Heart Fungus itself shuddering from the force of it.

subject: The Glyph of Warding
fact: The Glyph of Warding is inscribed on the bridge to detonate on anyone approaching from Jorlan’s side, regardless of their alignment or motives.
source_quote: The glyph waits on the bridge for whoever tries to reinforce her.

subject: The Glyph of Warding
fact: The Glyph of Warding detonates on Jorlan, killing one spore servant and severely damaging another and the Heart Fungus.
source_quote: the detonation is immediate and total — 21 damage, one spore servant gone to nothing, another barely holding itself together, and the Heart Fungus itself shuddering from the force of it.

subject: The Dust of Suleiman
fact: The Dust of Suleiman is most valuable as infrastructure demolition, not as a direct weapon against Ilvara.
source_quote: The Dust of Suleiman, which I had been imagining pouring down on Ilvara directly, was actually more valuable as infrastructure demolition.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is Thorin’s sword, which he wields with precision and skill in melee combat against Jorlan.
source_quote: Now I have Dawnbringer in hand — the real hand, the right hand, the one that knows what it's doing...

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer catches ambient light and turns it into something brighter, defying the darkness of the Underdark.
source_quote: The blade catches some ambient light from somewhere and turns it into something brighter, something that has no business existing this deep underground.

subject: The Spore Servants
fact: The Spore Servants are former drow who have been hollowed out by Ilvara’s spores and now serve as shambling, corrupted enforcers.
source_quote: four of them, former Velkynvelve guards, shambling and wrong

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker reflects on the moral cost of the glyph — it kills without discrimination, and they cannot design one that only kills enemies.
source_quote: I don't know how to inscribe a glyph that will only kill the drow that we don't like.

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker chooses to target the Heart Fungus with the Dust of Suleiman, accepting Asha’s insight over personal satisfaction.
source_quote: The Dust of Suleiman on the fungus, because Asha was right and the infrastructure was more important than the satisfying image of Ilvara's nightmares eating her alive.

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker notes that they chose Asha over Jorlan, and the glyph reflects that choice, even though Jorlan hates Ilvara.
source_quote: We'd made our choice between the two of them, and the glyph would reflect it.

subject: The Speaker
fact: The speaker acknowledges that the plan is flawed, but workable — and that survival depends on execution, not perfection.
source_quote: A workable one. Jorlan was not our ally, even if he hated Ilvara. We'd made our choice between the two of them, and the glyph would reflect it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is grinding the Heart Fungus down with something that sounds like the word *Suleiman* and delivers twenty force damage per turn like a promise.
source_quote: Grygum is grinding the Heart Fungus down with something that sounds like the word *Suleiman* and delivers twenty force damage per turn like a promise.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz opens up with a Fireball shaped so precisely around his allies that it catches Ilvara and her precious mushroom icon in the center of it, 24 damage worth of fire finding her even through her save, and the icon smolders.
source_quote: Daz opens up with a Fireball shaped so precisely around his allies that it catches Ilvara and her precious mushroom icon in the center of it, 24 damage worth of fire finding her even through her save, and the icon smolders.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is bleeding.
source_quote: Ilvara is bleeding.

subject: Ilvara
fact: The mushroom icon smolders.
source_quote: the icon smolders.

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is still in front of me.
source_quote: Jorlan is still in front of me.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is still in my hand.
source_quote: Dawnbringer is still in my hand.
